jobs.title: Senior Lead Program Manager, Client Project Delivery - Professional Consulting Services (RapidScale) (Remote)
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

At RapidScale, exceptional technology is powered by exceptional people. We deliver secure, reliable managed and advisory services across private, public, and hybrid clouds, helping organizations innovate, adapt, and grow. As an Elite Broadcom VMware VCSP Partner and top partner with AWS, Azure, and Google, our solutions focus on business outcomes, with embedded cyber resiliency and AI to protect today and enable tomorrow, all backed by the scale and strength of Spectrum.

The Senior Lead Project / Program Manager leads large, complex, enterprise initiatives that span multiple technical teams, business functions, and organizational priorities. This role provides strategic leadership across the full project and program lifecycle while serving as a trusted partner to professional services leadership, , Operations, Architecture, and executive stakeholders. As a recognized subject matter expert, the Senior Lead Project / Program Manager drives execution of highly complex technical initiatives, establishes scalable governance and delivery frameworks, pilots new operating models, and influences strategy through disciplined program management, risk mitigation, and operational excellence. This role owns strategic portfolios of related initiatives, balances competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, and continuously improves how Engineering delivers business value.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Lead large, complex projects and strategic programs involving multiple technical teams, cross-functional dependencies, executive stakeholders, and organizational priorities.
- Provide leadership across the complete project and program lifecycle, including intake, planning, estimation, governance, dependency management, risk assessment, execution, implementation, scope management, change management, and post-implementation review.
- Partner closely with Professional Services leaders, architects, Operations, and business stakeholders to successfully deliver complex technical initiatives involving cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, networking, security, software delivery, automation, and operational systems.
- Apply strong technical judgment to understand engineering architecture, delivery dependencies, implementation risks, and operational impacts while facilitating informed decision-making and removing delivery obstacles.
- Serve as a recognized subject matter expert within Engineering, Sales, and Project Management, providing guidance on delivery strategy, governance, prioritization, issue resolution, and organizational execution.
- Own strategic portfolios of related initiatives, balancing competing priorities, organizational risk, resource constraints, funding considerations, and executive expectations to maximize customer and business value.
- Pilot new project workflows, delivery methodologies, governance models, and project types; document lessons learned; and operationalize successful practices across the Professional Services organization.
- Define, implement, and continuously improve enterprise project and program management standards, governance frameworks, and delivery best practices that improve consistency, predictability, and execution quality across Professional Services.
- Build strong partnerships with senior leaders, directors, vice presidents, and executives by developing business cases, executive presentations, ROI analyses, status reporting, and strategic recommendations that support informed decision-making.
- Identify systemic delivery risks, organizational dependencies, and process improvement opportunities that enhance engineering execution, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and business performance.
- Manage scope across multiple engagements and prevent scope creep through proper documentation, escalation and change control processes.
- Establish meaningful success metrics across engineering programs, including delivery predictability, customer satisfaction, operational performance, resource utilization, financial outcomes, quality, and organizational effectiveness.
- Coach and mentor project managers and cross-functional team members by sharing best practices, strengthening delivery capabilities, and advancing project and program management maturity across the organization.

Qualifications & Attributes
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field and 8 or more years of experience leading complex engineering projects, enterprise programs, technical product delivery, or management consulting. The right candidate could also have a master's degree with 6 or more years of experience, a Ph.D. with 3 or more years of experience, or 12 or more years of related professional experience.
- Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale engineering projects and strategic programs spanning multiple organizations, technologies, executive stakeholders, and business functions.
- Strong understanding of engineering delivery methodologies (waterfall and agile), project and program governance, portfolio management, dependency management, risk management, tight scope management, software development lifecycles, cloud infrastructure, and operational delivery models.
- Demonstrated technical credibility with the ability to understand technical architecture, infrastructure modernization, cloud platforms, software delivery, technical dependencies, and implementation risks without serving as the technical design authority.
- Proven ability to influence strategy, delivery approaches, governance decisions, and organizational priorities through data-driven recommendations and executive-level communication.
- Experience designing and implementing scalable project management frameworks, governance processes, operating models, playbooks, and delivery standards that improve organizational effectiveness.
- Demonstrated ability to oversee the coordinated work of multiple teams and individuals, influence without direct authority, and successfully lead complex cross-functional initiatives in highly matrixed organizations.
- Exceptional executive communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trust and influence decisions at all organizational levels.
- Strong business acumen with experience applying financial analysis, ROI evaluation, prioritization frameworks, and strategic planning to engineering investments and delivery decisions.
- Demonstrated success operating independently in ambiguous environments while managing competing priorities, organizational change, and evolving business objectives.
- Passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and advancing the maturity of consulting and professional services project and program management practices across the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Engagement-  Risk & Resilience (RapidScale) (Remote)
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

At RapidScale, exceptional technology is powered by exceptional people. We deliver secure, reliable managed and advisory services across private, public, and hybrid clouds, helping organizations innovate, adapt, and grow. As an Elite Broadcom VMware VCSP Partner and top partner with AWS, Azure, and Google, our solutions focus on business outcomes, with embedded cyber resiliency and AI to protect today and enable tomorrow, all backed by the scale and strength of Spectrum.

RapidScale is building a Risk & Resilience advisory practice designed to help enterprise clients navigate increasingly complex challenges across business resilience, governance, cybersecurity, cloud transformation, artificial intelligence, compliance, exposure management, and operational readiness.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Strategy & Engagement – Risk & Resilience to provide senior advisory, commercial, and delivery leadership across the practice. This role will help shape major enterprise pursuits, oversee a portfolio of client engagements, establish strong commercial and delivery governance, and ensure RapidScale brings an integrated Risk & Resilience perspective to complex client challenges.

The Senior Manager will operate across the full lifecycle of the practice—from opportunity development and pursuit strategy through solution shaping, pricing and scope governance, delivery oversight, and executive client engagement.

This is not a traditional program management role or a purely technical cybersecurity position. The ideal candidate is a senior consulting-trained Risk & Resilience practitioner who can move comfortably between executive advisory conversations, complex pursuit leadership, commercial decision-making, and delivery oversight.

The role requires the ability to connect enterprise risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, cloud, governance, and compliance into a cohesive business-facing advisory strategy while bringing the consulting discipline and commercial judgment necessary to help scale a growing practice.

What You’ll Do

Portfolio & Advisory Leadership
- Provide senior leadership across a portfolio of Risk & Resilience pursuits and client engagements.
- Establish priorities across active opportunities and delivery workstreams based on client needs, strategic value, resource requirements, risk, and commercial considerations.
- Serve as a senior advisor to enterprise clients navigating complex issues involving risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, cloud, governance, compliance, and operational readiness.
- Lead executive-level conversations with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, risk, compliance, security, and transformation leaders.
- Help clients translate complex business and technology risks into actionable strategies, investment priorities, roadmaps, and transformation plans.
- Provide senior review and guidance on client recommendations, executive deliverables, and strategic readouts.

Major Pursuit & Solution Leadership
- Lead the shaping of complex, strategic, and high-value Risk & Resilience pursuits.
- Partner with sales, practice leadership, and technical subject matter experts to define the client problem, advisory approach, scope, solution, and value proposition.
- Lead or provide senior oversight for discovery sessions, executive workshops, proposal development, and pursuit presentations.
- Determine the appropriate combination of advisory, cybersecurity, cloud, AI, compliance, and delivery capabilities required to address client needs.
- Ensure pursuits are structured around measurable client outcomes rather than isolated technical activities.
- Provide senior-level support for strategic client presentations and executive decision-making throughout the pursuit lifecycle.

Commercial Governance
- Provide oversight for SOW development, pricing, scope, assumptions, resource models, and engagement economics across Risk & Resilience opportunities.
- Evaluate proposed engagements for delivery feasibility, commercial risk, and alignment with practice capabilities.
- Partner with practice and business leadership to validate pricing strategies and delivery models for complex engagements.
- Identify potential scope, margin, delivery, or resource risks before commitments are made to clients.
- Help establish repeatable commercial guardrails and pricing approaches as the practice scales.
- Ensure that what is sold can be successfully delivered and that client expectations are appropriately established throughout the pursuit process.

Delivery Oversight
- Provide senior oversight across multiple concurrent Risk & Resilience engagements.
- Establish delivery expectations and governance for complex or high-visibility client work.
- Monitor engagement health, client satisfaction, scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and overall quality.
- Provide escalation support when delivery challenges arise and help teams develop appropriate remediation plans.
- Ensure consistency and quality across executive deliverables, recommendations, assessments, and client readouts.
- Coach engagement leaders and subject matter experts on client management, problem structuring, executive communication, and consulting discipline.
- Maintain connectivity between pursuit strategy and delivery execution to ensure commitments made during the sales process translate into successful client outcomes.

Practice Development & Growth
- Partner with the Practice Lead to develop and scale RapidScale’s Risk & Resilience advisory capabilities.
- Help define repeatable offerings, methodologies, frameworks, delivery models, pricing approaches, and quality standards.
- Identify emerging client needs and translate them into new or expanded advisory offerings.
- Develop reusable intellectual property, assessment tools, SOW frameworks, executive materials, and seller enablement.
- Help build organizational capability across Risk & Resilience by mentoring team members and coordinating expertise across security, cloud, AI, compliance, and delivery.
- Support internal education and enablement to help sellers identify, qualify, and position Risk & Resilience opportunities.
- Contribute to the overall growth, market positioning, and maturity of the practice.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of enterprise technology sales experience. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a Master’s degree with 6 years of experience, a Ph.D. with 3 years of related experience, or 12 years of directly related experience.
- Significant experience in consulting, advisory services, risk, resilience, cybersecurity, technology transformation, or a related discipline.
- Experience leading complex enterprise consulting or advisory engagements involving multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and subject matter experts.
- Experience shaping complex client opportunities and translating ambiguous business challenges into structured advisory solutions.
- Experience developing and reviewing SOWs, proposals, pricing approaches, scopes, resource models, and engagement plans.
- Experience providing delivery leadership or oversight across multiple concurrent client engagements or workstreams.
- Experience engaging and advising senior enterprise stakeholders and executives.
- Working knowledge across enterprise risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, cloud, governance, and/or compliance.
- Demonstrated ability to identify and manage commercial, delivery, scope, and client risks.
- Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex business and technology issues into clear recommendations and decisions.

Preferred Qualifications
- Prior experience in a leading consulting or advisory environment, including Accenture, Big Four, MBB, or a comparable enterprise consulting/advisory firm.
- Significant consulting experience supporting enterprise clients across risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, cloud transformation, governance, compliance, or operational readiness.
- Demonstrated depth in at least two of the following areas: risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, or cloud, with strong fluency across adjacent disciplines.
- Experience serving as a senior advisor to CIO, CISO, CTO, risk, compliance, security, and transformation executives.
- Experience leading major or complex enterprise pursuits from qualification and discovery through proposal, commercial negotiation, and transition to delivery.
- Experience with consulting engagement economics, pricing, resource modeling, scope governance, and commercial risk management.
- Experience overseeing a portfolio of consulting or professional services engagements.
- Experience establishing delivery governance, quality standards, methodologies, or practice operating models.
- Experience developing new consulting offerings, methodologies, frameworks, intellectual property, or go-to-market capabilities.
- Experience mentoring consultants, engagement managers, or other advisory professionals.
- Experience operating across both pre-sales/pursuit activity and post-sale delivery within an enterprise consulting or professional services organization.

jobs.title: VP, Indirect Procurement
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

Spectrum's high-quality connectivity services depend on the collaboration and effectiveness of our Procurement team. We deliver value through innovative commercial expertise and strategic business solutions that support the delivery of advanced products and services and create positive customer experiences. The relationships we build with internal stakeholders and suppliers advance our evolving business goals and help keep innovative products affordable for Spectrum customers.

SUMMARY
The Vice President, Indirect Procurement is a key member of the Spectrum Procurement Leadership Team, reporting directly to the SVP, Strategic Procurement. This is a fast-paced, high-expectation seat: the team leading Spectrum's ~$10B indirect spend portfolio has already transformed how the function operates, and the VP must be able to keep pace from day one, sustaining well-informed, data-driven decision-making, rigorous risk management, and a track record of delivering significant, measurable value to the business nationally.

HOW THE VICE PRESIDENT, INDIRECT PROCUREMENT MAKES AN IMPACT
This position leads Spectrum's Indirect Procurement spend categories, with annual spend of ~$10B across software/technology, telecommunications, contingent labor, professional services, HR benefits and insurance, training, uniforms, physical security services, and sales & marketing. The role sets strategic sourcing direction in partnership with BU stakeholders and leads the team responsible for Indirect Procurement.
- Exploit critical savings opportunities by leveraging company-wide purchasing volume, advising business lines on opportunities that enhance profitability.
- Strategic Sourcing Execution: - Lead complex strategy development, negotiations, and robust supply agreements
- Champion well-informed, data-driven decision-making across the function, using AI and advanced tools where they add value
- Develop deep, long-term partnerships with strategic suppliers to improve quality, lead times, responsiveness, and innovation
- Establish communication plans on procurement activities for key stakeholders
- Develop creative solutions to complex sourcing and business challenges

- Attract, develop, mentor, and retain top talent, with clear performance measurement and continuous feedback for each direct report.
- Lead and elevate an already high-performing, AI-ready team, sustaining a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Build strong relationships with senior leaders and stay actively involved in company initiatives, ensuring strategic sourcing input is embedded in major corporate decisions.
- Mitigate supply chain risk — geopolitical, tariff, supplier-concentration, cyber, and disruption — by developing and managing risk mitigation strategies in close collaboration with Spectrum stakeholders, business units, and suppliers.
- Identify and execute continuous improvement initiatives that deliver year-over-year reductions in total sourcing spend.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO SPECTRUM
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 10+ years as a senior procurement leader with a demonstrated track record of delivering significant, measurable value at pace — currently operating as a Head of Procurement or a regional/national VP — within national or global sourcing and cost management at a publicly traded company.
- Proven ability to operate within a high-performing, already-mature procurement organization — quickly earning credibility and sustaining momentum, rather than needing to build capability from the ground up.
- 5+ years in a management/executive leadership role, with proven people-management skills: hiring, developing, coaching, delegating, and succession planning.
- Demonstrated strength in both strategic thinking and operational execution, including building new sourcing approaches from the ground up.
- High commercial and financial acumen, with the gravitas to influence at the Management Committee level and build strong cross-functional relationships with Finance and business teams.
- Seasoned negotiator with a track record of complex, multi-million-dollar deals; skilled at navigating high-pressure situations with diplomacy and sound judgment; strong partner to third-party procurement service providers.
- Strong communicator, able to translate complex procurement and sourcing issues clearly for suppliers, peers, and senior leadership.
- Sharp analytical and strategic instincts, with a clear, calm approach under pressure.
- High cultural awareness and a track record of building strong relationships across a diverse set of internal and external stakeholders.

REQUIRED EDUCATION
- Bachelor's degree required

PREFERRED EDUCATION
- MBA

WORKING CONDITIONS
- Office environment
- Willingness to travel an estimated 10–15% to accommodate business needs

jobs.description:

When working through a challenge, are you analytical, thoughtful, and calm? Are you a strong problem solver and decision maker, even in a high-volume, fast-paced environment? If so, you may be a fit for our Senior Procurement Manager position!

BE PART OF THE CONNECTION

As a Senior Procurement Manager , you will independently lead cross-functional teams to strategically select top-quality products and suppliers at the most competitive prices and overall terms. You will be a driving force in continually seeking out opportunities to reduce costs, mitigate risks, and improve business conditions. Working in close partnership with internal stakeholders, you will identify and define their requirements, and draft, negotiate, and manage complex contracts. Your expertise in supplier relationship management will ensure that we maintain productive and mutually beneficial partnerships over the long term. You will act as a trusted resource for solving business issues, leveraging your deep understanding of procurement strategies to provide innovative and effective solutions.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT
- Leading the negotiation and contract management of large-scale, enterprise-wide volume purchase agreements without guidance.
- Demonstrating project management expertise with the ability to carry projects from strategic planning through implementation.
- Leading cross functional teams to develop meaningful requirements to ensure quality responses from suppliers.
- Researching and developing adequate sources of supply.
- Utilizing supply market knowledge to leverage best strategy for Charter.
- Leading cross functional supplier selection activities through management of formal RFP, RFQ and RFI processes.
- Evaluating the financial stability of potential suppliers.
- Performing required business analysis with a strategic focus on total cost of ownership.
- Providing fact-based recommendations to executive level management for constructing the best overall strategic buy decisions.
- Continuously seeking out cost savings opportunities and leading efforts to realize the savings.
- Managing overall supplier performance using Strategic Relationship Management tool set – including acting as an escalation point in the event of non-performance.
- Independently developing a strategic category plan based on an understanding of business goals and objectives, the supply market and benchmarking.
- Effectively documenting, communicating and gaining buy-in across the organization to ensure alignment.
- Managing stakeholder groups through technology adoption.
- Working beyond the traditional procurement metrics to achieve operational and technical improvements to the business process.

As part of the Procurement Department, you will be a driving force behind the strategic sourcing and purchasing of goods and services that power Spectrum. Our expertise in securing the best possible price, quality, and overall value helps to ensure Spectrum’s continued growth and success. Through strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders, we work tirelessly to bring innovation and efficiency to every aspect of our procurement process.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO SPECTRUM

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Procurement contract negotiation and contract management experience - 5+ years
- Electronic procurement and or contract solutions experience - 1-3 years
- Direct industry or company experience – 2 years
- Proven ability to manage and influence all phases of change management
- Comprehensive understanding of the P2P process

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business or Supply Chain Management preferred

Working Conditions
- Hybrid Schedule

Our HR team plays the integral role of keeping our employees happy, growing, protected, and insured. We understand the importance and value each employee has in making Spectrum successful, so we drive and improve the dedicated resources and programs that serve our people. If you value relationships and are people-first, a career as a HR Manager at Spectrum is for you.

The Human Resources Manager plays a vital role in implementing and managing human resources policies and programs. The HR Manager will oversee areas of recruitment, employee relations, organizational effectiveness, and performance management, all of which are aligned with company goals. You’ll work closely with the leadership team to support and implement effective short and long-term strategies to achieve organizational objectives. As you efficiently manage employee interactions, your goal is to provide excellent service with an appropriate sense of urgency.

How You’ll Make an Impact
- Partner with respective client groups to understand their business challenges and to ensure effective and timely HR support.
- Provide day-to-day performance management guidance to managers (coaching, counseling, career development, corrective actions, etc.) and plays an instrumental role in the administration of the annual performance management and compensation planning processes.
- Maintain employee files in the HRIS database to analyze trends and metrics to recommend, design, and implement solutions, programs, and processes that will drive organizational effectiveness.
- Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) including recruiting, compensation, benefits, employee relations, etc.) to provide best-in-class HR support and programs to assigned client groups.
- Participate in enterprise-wide HR initiatives to effectively manage organizational changes.
- Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues including EthicsPoint reports and conduct thorough and objective investigations; assist with unemployment and workers compensation claims, leave administration, and ADA accommodations.

- Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business or organizational behavior or related field or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager IV (RapidScale) (Remote)
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

At RapidScale, exceptional technology is powered by exceptional people. We deliver secure, reliable managed and advisory services across private, public, and hybrid clouds, helping organizations innovate, adapt, and grow. As an Elite Broadcom VMware VCSP Partner and top partner with AWS, Azure, and Google, our solutions focus on business outcomes, with embedded cyber resiliency and AI to protect today and enable tomorrow, all backed by the scale and strength of Spectrum.

RapidScale is evolving Customer Success into a core, revenue-adjacent capability focused on ensuring customers realize measurable business outcomes, improving retention, and enabling expansion.

The Customer Success Manager IV is responsible for owning customer outcomes and value realization across a portfolio of enterprise customers, while acting as a quarterback across Sales, Delivery, Operations, Consulting, and Support.
This role ensures customers experience RapidScale as one accountable partner, driving retention, adoption, and long-term value.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Outcomes and Value Realization

- Own accountability for ensuring customers realize the business outcomes and value aligned to their RapidScale solutions
- Develop and maintain Outcome-Based Success Plans tied to customer objectives, KPIs, and milestones
- Ensure delivery and operational activities remain aligned to outcomes, not just scope completion
- Lead customer conversations focused on value realization, adoption, and forward roadmap alignment

Customer Lifecycle Management

- Manage a portfolio of strategic customers across onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion phases
- Proactively identify risks to retention and develop mitigation plans
- Ensure consistent execution of lifecycle touchpoints including onboarding, QBRs, and renewal readiness

Cross-Functional Orchestration

- Act as the primary point of accountability and coordination across Sales, Delivery, Operations, Consulting, Support, and Engineering
- Drive alignment across teams to ensure seamless customer experience and execution
- Resolve cross-functional issues impacting customer outcomes or timelines

Retention, Renewal and Expansion Support

- Partner closely with Sales and Account Management to support renewal strategy and execution
- Ensure renewal conversations are grounded in delivered value and measurable outcomes
- Identify opportunities for expansion and surface Customer Success Qualified Leads

Customer Experience and Engagement

- Lead QBRs and executive-level discussions focused on outcomes achieved, value delivered, and future opportunities
- Maintain proactive communication and transparency with customers
- Strengthen customer relationships and advocacy

Program and Process Contribution

- Contribute to the development and refinement of Customer Success playbooks and engagement models
- Support standardization of best practices across customer segments
- Provide feedback to improve tools, processes, and operating cadence

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline and 8 years of experience in a related field
- Or a master’s degree with 6 years of experience
- Or a PhD with 3 years of experience
- Or 12 years of relevant professional experience

Core Experience
- Experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Account Management, or Consulting within B2B technology or services environments
- Experience working with enterprise customers in managed services, cloud, SaaS, or complex delivery environments
- Proven ability to manage customer relationships and drive value realization
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience working cross-functionally in matrixed organizations
- Owns highly complex or strategic enterprise customer relationships
- Acts as a senior quarterback across functions, influencing execution across teams
- Drives improvements to Customer Success programs and engagement models
- Mentors other Customer Success team members and elevates overall team capability
- Plays a key role in shaping how Customer Success scales across the organization

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in managed services, cloud, or hybrid infrastructure environments
- Experience driving retention and expansion within enterprise accounts
- Familiarity with Customer Success metrics such as GRR, NRR, and customer health scoring
- Experience leading executive-level customer conversations

jobs.title: Strategy & Engagement Manager, Risk & Resilience (RapidScale) (Remote)
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

At RapidScale, exceptional technology is powered by exceptional people. We deliver secure, reliable managed and advisory services across private, public, and hybrid clouds, helping organizations innovate, adapt, and grow. As an Elite Broadcom VMware VCSP Partner and top partner with AWS, Azure, and Google, our solutions focus on business outcomes, with embedded cyber resiliency and AI to protect today and enable tomorrow, all backed by the scale and strength of Spectrum.

RapidScale is building a Risk & Resilience advisory practice designed to help enterprise clients navigate increasingly complex challenges across business resilience, governance, cybersecurity, cloud transformation, artificial intelligence, compliance, exposure management, and operational readiness.

We are seeking a Strategy & Engagement Manager, Risk & Resilience to help shape and deliver this growing advisory capability. This individual will work across client pursuits and engagements helping define complex business problems, structure advisory solutions, lead client workstreams, coordinate subject matter experts, and translate risk and technology challenges into practical strategies and execution plans.

This is not a traditional project management or coordination role, nor is it a purely technical cybersecurity position. The ideal candidate brings a strong consulting and advisory mindset and is comfortable operating at the intersection of business strategy, risk, technology, and transformation.

In this role, you will work directly with enterprise clients and internal experts across security, cloud, AI, compliance, and delivery while also helping build the methods, tools, and intellectual property that will support the continued growth of RapidScale's Risk & Resilience practice.

What You'll Do

Client Advisory & Engagement Leadership
- Partner with clients to define and structure complex challenges related to enterprise risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, cloud, governance, compliance, and operational readiness.
- Lead advisory workstreams from discovery and problem definition through recommendations, execution planning, and executive readout.
- Prepare and facilitate client workshops with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, risk, compliance, security, and transformation leaders.
- Translate business and technology risks into clear priorities, recommendations, roadmaps, and practical execution plans.
- Develop executive-ready presentations, assessments, recommendations, and client deliverables.
- Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and effectively navigate complex enterprise environments.

Pursuit & Solution Development
- Support opportunity qualification, client discovery, pursuit strategy, and solution shaping for enterprise Risk & Resilience opportunities.
- Develop scopes of work, proposals, engagement approaches, workplans, and supporting client materials.
- Partner with practice leadership on pricing, scope validation, assumptions, resource requirements, and delivery models.
- Help ensure proposed solutions connect client business objectives with risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, cloud, governance, and compliance considerations.
- Collaborate with sales teams and technical subject matter experts to translate client needs into compelling advisory solutions.

Engagement Execution
- Develop engagement workplans and lead day-to-day execution across active client workstreams.
- Coordinate subject matter experts across cybersecurity, cloud, AI, compliance, architecture, and delivery while maintaining ownership of the broader client outcome.
- Identify risks, dependencies, decisions, and actions throughout engagements and ensure they are effectively communicated and managed.
- Maintain strong client and executive communication throughout the engagement lifecycle.
- Balance multiple pursuits and client engagements in a fast-moving environment.

Practice Development
- Help develop repeatable Risk & Resilience methodologies, frameworks, SOW templates, assessment approaches, and delivery assets.
- Create reusable client- and seller-facing collateral that supports the continued growth of the practice.
- Contribute to seller enablement and help internal teams identify and position Risk & Resilience opportunities.
- Capture lessons learned and translate client engagements into scalable practice capabilities.
- Partner with practice leadership to continue evolving RapidScale's Risk & Resilience advisory point of view and go-to-market approach.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline and 6 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and 4 years’ experience; a Ph.D. and 1 year of experience; or 10 years’ experience in a related field.
- Experience in consulting, advisory services, risk, resilience, cybersecurity, technology transformation, or a related discipline.
- Experience structuring complex or ambiguous business problems and translating them into clear, actionable recommendations and execution plans.
- Experience leading client-facing workstreams or complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and subject matter experts.
- Experience developing executive-level presentations, recommendations, proposals, scopes of work, workplans, or other client-facing deliverables.
- Working knowledge of enterprise risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, cloud, governance, or compliance concepts.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex business and technology topics to both technical and executive audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Prior experience in a consulting or advisory environment, including experience with Accenture, Big Four, MBB, or a comparable enterprise consulting/advisory firm.
- Consulting experience supporting enterprise clients across risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, cloud transformation, governance, compliance, or operational readiness.
- Demonstrated depth in at least two of the following areas: risk, resilience, cybersecurity, AI, or cloud, with sufficient fluency across the others to connect them into a broader business-facing advisory strategy.
- Experience engaging with CIO, CISO, CTO, risk, compliance, security, and/or transformation executives.
- Experience facilitating executive workshops, discovery sessions, assessments, or strategic planning sessions.
- Experience developing SOWs, proposals, pricing approaches, scope assumptions, and engagement models for professional or advisory services.
- Strong executive presentation and slide-development skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into concise, decision-oriented recommendations.
- Experience coordinating cross-functional subject matter experts while maintaining ownership of the broader client problem, workstream, and outcome.
- Experience developing consulting methodologies, frameworks, assessment tools, reusable collateral, or other practice-building assets.
- Experience supporting both pre-sales/pursuit activity and post-sale delivery within a consulting or professional services environment.

Who Will Be Successful in This Role

The successful candidate will be someone who enjoys working on complex problems that do not always have an obvious answer. You can walk into an ambiguous client situation, ask the right questions, bring structure to the problem, engage the appropriate expertise, and translate that work into a clear recommendation and actionable plan.
You are comfortable discussing risk and resilience with business executives while also working alongside cybersecurity, cloud, AI, compliance, and technical specialists. You do not need to be the deepest technical expert in every domain, but you understand these areas well enough to connect them, challenge assumptions, and help guide clients toward meaningful business outcomes.

Most importantly, you enjoy building. This role provides the opportunity not only to shape and deliver client engagements, but also to help develop the methodologies, offerings, and operating model of a growing enterprise Risk & Resilience advisory practice.

- Identify opportunities to improve scalability, consistency, and effectiveness across the Customer Success organization.

- Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline and 8 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and 6 years’ experience; a Ph.D. and 3 years’ experience in a related field; or 12 years’ experience in a related field.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager III (RapidScale) (Remote)
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

At RapidScale, exceptional technology is powered by exceptional people. We deliver secure, reliable managed and advisory services across private, public, and hybrid clouds, helping organizations innovate, adapt, and grow. As an Elite Broadcom VMware VCSP Partner and top partner with AWS, Azure, and Google, our solutions focus on business outcomes, with embedded cyber resiliency and AI to protect today and enable tomorrow, all backed by the scale and strength of Spectrum.

RapidScale is evolving Customer Success into a core, revenue-adjacent capability focused on ensuring customers realize measurable business outcomes, improving customer retention, and supporting long-term growth. The Customer Success Manager III is responsible for managing a portfolio of customers and helping them achieve successful adoption of RapidScale solutions while delivering an exceptional customer experience. This role partners closely with Sales, Delivery, Operations, Consulting, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers receive consistent service, realize ongoing value from their investments, and are well positioned for long-term success. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, highly organized, and collaborative, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while building trusted relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Success & Value Realization
- Manage a portfolio of assigned customers, serving as their primary Customer Success contact.
- Develop and maintain Customer Success Plans aligned to customer business objectives and desired outcomes.
- Monitor customer adoption, utilization, and overall health to proactively identify opportunities and potential risks.
- Partner with customers to help maximize the value of RapidScale solutions throughout their lifecycle.
- Escalate customer concerns appropriately while coordinating internal resources to drive timely resolution.

Customer Lifecycle Management
- Guide customers through onboarding, adoption, ongoing engagement, and renewal readiness activities.
- Conduct regular customer touchpoints and business reviews to ensure continued alignment with customer goals.
- Maintain accurate customer account documentation, engagement plans, and success metrics.
- Identify potential risks to customer satisfaction and retention while developing appropriate mitigation plans.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Operations, Consulting, Engineering, and Support to deliver a seamless customer experience.
- Coordinate internal resources to ensure customer needs are addressed efficiently.
- Facilitate communication between customers and internal teams throughout the customer lifecycle.
- Escalate customer issues and risks as appropriate while helping drive resolution.

Retention & Growth Support
- Support renewal activities by demonstrating customer value and business outcomes.
- Identify opportunities for additional solutions or services and communicate them to the appropriate Sales partners.
- Contribute to customer retention efforts through proactive engagement and relationship management.

Customer Experience
- Build trusted relationships through consistent communication and responsiveness.
- Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) or other customer meetings appropriate to the customer's engagement model.
- Ensure customers understand available resources, services, and best practices to maximize success.
- Promote a positive customer experience through proactive engagement and follow-through.

Process Improvement
- Follow established Customer Success methodologies, playbooks, and operational processes.
- Provide feedback to leadership on opportunities to improve customer experience, tools, and operational processes.
- Participate in team initiatives, training, and continuous improvement efforts.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum
- Bachelor's degree in a related discipline and 6 years' experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and 4 years' experience; a Ph.D. and up to 2 year of experience; or 8 years' experience in a related field.

Core Experience
- Experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Account Management, Customer Experience, or Consulting within a B2B technology or services environment.
- Experience managing customer relationships and supporting customer adoption, retention, and satisfaction.
- Strong communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customers and priorities simultaneously.
- Experience using CRM and Customer Success platforms to manage customer engagement activities.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting customers in managed services, cloud, SaaS, cybersecurity, or hybrid infrastructure environments.
- Familiarity with Customer Success metrics such as customer health, adoption, retention, and renewal readiness.
- Experience facilitating customer business reviews and presenting customer performance metrics.
- Working knowledge of cloud technologies including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, VMware, or related technologies.
- Experience identifying customer growth opportunities and partnering with Sales to support expansion.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager III (RapidScale) (Remote)
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

At RapidScale, exceptional technology is powered by exceptional people. We deliver secure, reliable managed and advisory services across private, public, and hybrid clouds, helping organizations innovate, adapt, and grow. As an Elite Broadcom VMware VCSP Partner and top partner with AWS, Azure, and Google, our solutions focus on business outcomes, with embedded cyber resiliency and AI to protect today and enable tomorrow, all backed by the scale and strength of Spectrum.

RapidScale is evolving Customer Success into a core, revenue-adjacent capability focused on ensuring customers realize measurable business outcomes, improving customer retention, and supporting long-term growth.

The Customer Success Manager III is responsible for managing a portfolio of customers and helping them achieve successful adoption of RapidScale solutions while delivering an exceptional customer experience. This role partners closely with Sales, Delivery, Operations, Consulting, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers receive consistent service, realize ongoing value from their investments, and are well positioned for long-term success. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, highly organized, and collaborative, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while building trusted relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Success & Value Realization
- Manage a portfolio of assigned customers, serving as their primary Customer Success contact.
- Develop and maintain Customer Success Plans aligned to customer business objectives and desired outcomes.
- Monitor customer adoption, utilization, and overall health to proactively identify opportunities and potential risks.
- Partner with customers to help maximize the value of RapidScale solutions throughout their lifecycle.
- Escalate customer concerns appropriately while coordinating internal resources to drive timely resolution.

Customer Lifecycle Management
- Guide customers through onboarding, adoption, ongoing engagement, and renewal readiness activities.
- Conduct regular customer touchpoints and business reviews to ensure continued alignment with customer goals.
- Maintain accurate customer account documentation, engagement plans, and success metrics.
- Identify potential risks to customer satisfaction and retention while developing appropriate mitigation plans.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Operations, Consulting, Engineering, and Support to deliver a seamless customer experience.
- Coordinate internal resources to ensure customer needs are addressed efficiently.
- Facilitate communication between customers and internal teams throughout the customer lifecycle.
- Escalate customer issues and risks as appropriate while helping drive resolution.

Retention & Growth Support
- Support renewal activities by demonstrating customer value and business outcomes.
- Identify opportunities for additional solutions or services and communicate them to the appropriate Sales partners.
- Contribute to customer retention efforts through proactive engagement and relationship management.

Customer Experience
- Build trusted relationships through consistent communication and responsiveness.
- Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) or other customer meetings appropriate to the customer's engagement model.
- Ensure customers understand available resources, services, and best practices to maximize success.
- Promote a positive customer experience through proactive engagement and follow-through.

Process Improvement
- Follow established Customer Success methodologies, playbooks, and operational processes.
- Provide feedback to leadership on opportunities to improve customer experience, tools, and operational processes.
- Participate in team initiatives, training, and continuous improvement efforts.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum
- Bachelor's degree in a related discipline and 6 years' experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and 4 years' experience; a Ph.D. and up to 2 year of experience; or 8 years' experience in a related field.

Core Experience
- Experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Account Management, Customer Experience, or Consulting within a B2B technology or services environment.
- Experience managing customer relationships and supporting customer adoption, retention, and satisfaction.
- Strong communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customers and priorities simultaneously.
- Experience using CRM and Customer Success platforms to manage customer engagement activities.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting customers in managed services, cloud, SaaS, cybersecurity, or hybrid infrastructure environments.
- Familiarity with Customer Success metrics such as customer health, adoption, retention, and renewal readiness.
- Experience facilitating customer business reviews and presenting customer performance metrics.
- Working knowledge of cloud technologies including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, VMware, or related technologies.
- Experience identifying customer growth opportunities and partnering with Sales to support expansion.

jobs.description:

At a Glance
- You’re a motivated student with a current 3.0 GPA or higher currently pursuing a degree in one of the following areas from an accredited college or university:
- Accounting, Business Administration, Business Technology Management, Communications, Criminal Justice, Sociology, Public Safety, Human Resources, IOS Psychology, Journalism, Liberal Arts, Political Science, History, English, Philosophy, Management and Organization, Marketing

- This is a paid, full-time, 11-week internship designed to give you real-world experience and meaningful exposure to the telecommunications industry in your chosen field.
- Internship program runs from May 26 through August 6, 2027.
- In addition to role-specific projects, you’ll take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, mentorship and experiences that help you grow personally and professionally.

The Spectrum Internship Experience
As part of America’s Connectivity Company®, you’ll join a team that serves millions of customers and communities nationwide, while gaining valuable insight into the work that powers connection every day.

Throughout the summer, you’ll contribute to meaningful work, strengthen your skills and have opportunities to:
- Grow your skills in a dynamic, innovative business environment.
- Build connections with team members and senior leaders who can help you better understand our business and what it’s like to work here.
- Learn from a mentor, who can provide guidance, support and career advice.

What you can expect in this role

As a Spectrum intern, you’ll spend the summer working alongside two teams: your respective department and your intern cohort.

Department and team-focused projects account for about 80% of your schedule. You’ll spend the other 20% on internship experiences that include a kickoff conference, professional development sessions and networking activities, webinars, community service, cross-functional projects and final presentations.

This experience is designed to help you explore your interests, expand your network and leave with a deeper understanding of both your field and the impact of our business.

Internship responsibilities may include:

The CPS Operations Intern will play a key role in supporting the Communications, Operations, and Training (COT) team, providing initiative support, data insights, and creative input that align with CPS short-and long-term priorities. This role is designed for a motivated individual who is eager to gain experience in operational strategy, project execution, and organizational effectiveness, as well as exposure to the field of physical security. - Must be currently enrolled in an accredited College or University completing a bachelor’s degree
- Must have at least a 3.0 GPA or greater in current program
- Ability to travel locally to Spectrum intern development events and activities throughout the program
- Authorization to work in the U.S. without restrictions or need for future sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications
- Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple tasks and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Demonstrated ability to drive results through effective project and time management

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with capability to exercise these skills across platforms (Outlook, Webex, In-Person)
